Fidelity hires software engineers through its 10-week Leap Program, designed to help participants transition from college into full-time engineering careers. Participants build and deploy applications, work across the software development lifecycle, explore AI tools, and contribute to technology supporting customers’ financial goals.
Financial Services
No H1B
Responsibilities
Build scalable applications and features using modern programming languages, traditional and newer database platforms, integration technologies (APIs, messaging), and user interfaces/front-end frameworks
Work on real projects from start to finish across the full software development lifecycle including requirements, design, development, testing, and deployment
Write code, test it, and deploy it with support from your team, leveraging standardized and automated software development pipeline practices and technologies that safely and securely move your code from development to production
Explore innovative technologies, including AI tools, and learn how to responsibly use them in your work to deliver cutting-edge capabilities and services for our customers
Work as part of an engineering team obsessed with delivery solutions that help our customers achieve their long-term financial goals
